min.description: the minimum value of the input stream, for string will return string of minimum length

max.description: the maximum value of the input stream, for string will return string of maximum length

invalidCount.description: number of elements that did not match the specified ValueType of this Digest

spec.description: Stores the spec for what statistics were calculated for this Digest

hyperLogLog.description: Stores input data in a HyperLogLog structure used for estimating unique count

countMinSketch.description: Stores input data in a CountMinSketch structure used for estimating frequent elements

minHash.description: Stores hashes of a subset of input data used for approximate inclusion tests

mean.description: the mean of the input stream

widestNumberType.description:
The widest number type that was added to this digest. The following number types are considered, from narrowest to
widest: Byte, Int16, Int32, Int, Double. Null if no numbers have been added to the digest.

histogram.description: Best approximation of distribution of the input stream

title: Summary statistics of a numeric value set.
name: NumericDigest
